column1: # Reference words: labels that make a number a business number, not personal data
# (pii_guard/languages/references.py; docs/languages.md). One entry per line, `#` comments,
# blank lines ignored. A trailing `*` lets the word take suffixes (`factura*`: `facturas`).
# Accents are optional in the text (`albaran` matches `albarán`). Spanish writes the number
# word before the noun (`número de pedido 7002...`), so the noun is the label's last word;
# after the noun it is `n.º`, `nº` or `núm.`, which the shared pattern does not know, so
# those spellings are listed with the nouns that take them. Optional second column: `both`
# (the default), `rules`, `ner`, or `weak` (a poor negative cue such as an amount word,
# honored by the rules check only).
# Every entry is `rules` for now: a pack word read by the NER check fails the pinned
# fallback test (tests/detect/test_reference_packs.py); LAB-1787 lifts that, and then these
